title: THE BLOCK: Securitize President Brett Redfearn says the SEC pulled back its crypto innovation exemption last Friday over concerns about the Clarity Act vote. Redfearn expects the rule to come after the Senate’s Sept. 15
snippet: THE BLOCK: Securitize President Brett Redfearn says the SEC pulled back its crypto innovation exemption last Friday over concerns about the Clarity Act vote. Redfearn expects the rule to come after the Senate’s Sept. 15 vote, likely in early October.

title: OCC races to finalize GENIUS Act stablecoin rules by November
snippet: The OCC is stepping on the gas to finalize rules by November to implement a stablecoin law signed by President Trump.

title: OCC head promises final GENIUS rules by November
snippet: The US banking regulator released a 376‑page proposal in February, calling for public comment on rules to implement the stablecoin bill ahead of its January 2027 effective date.

title: SEC regulatory proposal marks ‘important’ step forward from ‘inapt’ crypto rules: Commissioner Peirce
snippet: “Crypto mom” Hester Peirce praised the SEC’s proposed crypto regime, published days after the Senate failed to pass the CLARITY Act, the US’ first comprehensive industry framework.

title: Banking Regulator Races to Finalize GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules
snippet: OCC Comptroller Jonathan Gould told the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium the agency is moving at a rapid pace to beat a January statutory deadline, after already missing an earlier July target.

title: Cybersecurity firm unveils crypto phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers
snippet: Rapid7 unveiled a new cryptocurrency phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers, aiming to steal investors’ holdings by redirecting them to fake wallet provider websites.
